svg.title: How Enzora combines prediction evidence
svg.desc: Three soft-colour tiers match the supplied main workflow. Agent controls are run-level policy; measured uncertainty determines candidate-specific influence. The N32A score bar uses verified saved outputs, not fabricated example values.
svg.text: From model evidence to a candidate decision

svg.title: Enzora
svg.desc: A folded protein ribbon forms a flowing Z. One deep-blue segment marks a selected sequence residue.
svg.metadata: Original Enzora mark. Abstract folded-ribbon Z and selected-residue accent. Conceptual protein-folding and sequence-design symbol, not a depiction of a specific molecular structure.

svg.text: The Agent does not rewrite model predictions.
Colour: model evidence Grey: uncertainty adjustment towards 0.5
Schematics describe the policy; the candidate example uses recorded model outputs.
